name: GD Neural Pilot
description: Look-ahead autoplayer with an in-game menu. Single-player use.

autopilot.name: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Master ON/OFF switch for the autoplayer.

reaction-ms.name: Reaction time (ms)
reaction-ms.description: Delay between the bot deciding and the input being applied. 0 = frame-perfect.

prediction-distance.name: Prediction distance (units)
prediction-distance.description: How far ahead of the player the bot scans and simulates. 30 units = 1 block.

menu-key.name: Menu key
menu-key.description: Opens and closes the Neural Pilot menu.

toggle-key.name: Autopilot key
toggle-key.description: Turns the autopilot on and off.
